changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE documents ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, facility_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES facilities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, engineering_system_id BIGINT REFERENCES engineering_systems(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, document_type_id BIGINT REFERENCES document_types(id), name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, original_filename VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, storage_path VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, mime_type VARCHAR(255), size BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, page_count INT, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UPLOADED', error_message TEXT, actuality_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTUAL', version VARCHAR(64), document_date DATE, checksum VARCHAR(128), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX idx_documents_facility ON documents(facility_id); CREATE INDEX idx_documents_system ON documents(engineering_system_id); CREATE INDEX idx_documents_type ON documents(document_type_id); CREATE INDEX idx_documents_status ON documents(status);

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE equipment ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, facility_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES facilities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, engineering_system_id BIGINT REFERENCES engineering_systems(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, manufacturer VARCHAR(255), name VARCHAR(500), model VARCHAR(255), modification VARCHAR(255), quantity NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, unit VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'шт.', location VARCHAR(500), comment TEXT, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AUTO_EXTRACTED', created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX idx_equipment_facility ON equipment(facility_id); CREATE INDEX idx_equipment_system ON equipment(engineering_system_id);
